lean.statement:
∀ {E : Type u_1}
  [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E] {f : E → ℝ} {β : ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ 1 f →
    ((∀ (x y : E), f y ≤ f x + inner ℝ (gradient f x) (y - x) + β / 2 * ‖y - x‖ ^ 2) ↔
      ∀ (x y : E), inner ℝ (gradient f y - gradient f x) (y - x) ≤ β * ‖y - x‖ ^ 2)
approved_definition_context: ContDiff ℝ 1 f means f is continuously Frechet differentiable everywhere; ContDiff ℝ 2 f means f is twice continuously Frechet differentiable everywhere.
In a complete real inner-product space, gradient f x is the Riesz vector of fderiv ℝ f x: inner ℝ (gradient f x) v = fderiv ℝ f x v.
The expression (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) x v) v evaluates the second Frechet derivative twice at v. Under the displayed C2 regularity it is a genuine second derivative.
